cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: I Can Handle This
cards.instruction: Perform complete emotional readiness while quietly borrowing coping strategies from every response around you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm ready for the audition results. Shoulders down—remember our lessons. Why are you counting your breaths?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Four in, six out. It stops my hands shaking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Four in, six out. Good, you've refined the breathing I started you on. I always settle myself before opening results.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I also write down who I'll call if I don't get in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent follow-through. Hand me the pen. I'll show you how I order a list like that; who's first on yours?

reason: Use familiar training and pupil corrections as the method of the exact emotional pursuit; preserve partner contribution, acknowledge real responsibility, and avoid claiming every setback was a planned lesson.
